subject: reading json with httr, unable to authenticate

messages.author: 4114912dbf9e2d36
messages.subject: reading json with httr, unable to authenticate
parts:
Hey guys,

I want to access this API:
https://api.mmitnetwork.com/Home/QuickStart#Authentication

and it has some instructions on how to do it, but I don't know what language it is or how to translate it to R. The furthest I've gotten is this code:

library(httr)
req <- POST("https://api.mmitnetwork.com/Token",
            config = NULL,
            body = c("grant_type=password"))

This gives me 500 SERVER ERROR

An error occured on the MMIT API Server. Check the developerMessage for more information.


It gives me an error because I didn't pass it the username and password, but where do I do that? Everything else I've tried gives me Status Code 400 which is a bad request.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: reading json with httr, unable to authenticate
parts:
Here's a straightforward translation of

curl -X POST
-H "Accept: application/json"
-d {"grant_type":"password",
"username":"yourusername","password":"yourpassword"}
"https://api.mmitnetwork.com/Token"

which is command line curl, to httr:

library(httr)
POST("https://api.mmitnetwork.com/Token",
body = list(
grant_type = "password",
username = "yourusername",
password = "yourpassword"
),
encode = "json",
accept_json(body)
)

Hadley
